_comment: EDIT THIS FILE to change which words/phrases make the bot politely close the conversation and go silent for that customer. Matching is case-insensitive and accent-insensitive (ı=i, ş=s...). 'phrases' are matched as substrings of the whole message; 'words' must appear as whole words. After the closing message is sent, the bot stops replying to that phone number for 'muteHours' hours (their messages are still logged to the Sheet).

closingMessage.tr: Anlıyorum, rahatsız ettiysek özür dileriz. İyi günler dileriz! 🌟 Fikriniz değişirse buradayız.
closingMessage.en: Understood — sorry to have bothered you. Have a great day! 🌟 We're here if you ever change your mind.
